entries.title: Psalms 121:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents.>> I will lift up my eyes to the hills-From whence comes my help?

entries.title: Psalms 121:2
segments: My help [comes] from the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.

entries.title: Psalms 121:3
segments: He will not allow your foot to be moved; He who keeps you will not slumber.

entries.title: Psalms 121:4
segments: Behold, He who keeps Israel Shall neither slumber nor sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 121:5
segments: The LORD [is] your keeper; The LORD [is] your shade at your right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 121:6
segments: The sun shall not strike you by day, Nor the moon by night.

entries.title: Psalms 121:7
segments: The LORD shall preserve you from all evil; He shall preserve your soul.

entries.title: Psalms 121:8
segments: The LORD shall preserve your going out and your coming in From this time forth, and even forevermore.
